narrative.intro: Brookhaven Science Associates' federal contract obligations are $830M in FY2026 to date, with two awards totaling an average award size of $415M and obligations down 0.5% year over year. The Department of Energy accounts for $830M of obligations, while the National Aeronautics and Space Administration accounts for $16K. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) is the largest market at $830M. Historical obligations show multi-year activity: FY21 was $668M, FY22 was $951M, FY23 was $789M, FY24 was $797M, and FY25 was $834M. Current-year totals are partial because the figures cover fiscal year to date. The largest contract activity centers on DOE-funded research operations and related R D work, with a very small amount of NASA-funded work appearing in the current period. Use these figures to compare Brookhaven Science Associates to peers on contract size, agency concentration, and market focus for FY2026 to date.
